items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 60:1
items.html: It is known that there are two impregnations: the first impregnation for the sake of Katnut, and the second impregnation for the sake of Gadlut. Therefore the phase of the reflected light that clothes the level of the first impregnation is called the Tzelem of impregnation, or the Tzelem of Elokim, which is judgments and Katnut. And the phase of reflected light that clothes the Mochin at the time of the second impregnation is called the Tzelem of Gadlut, or the Tzelem of HaVaYaH, which are mercy. (Item 147)
